content: जुष् I. €6 <ab>Ā.</ab> (जुषते-जुष्ट) .²1 To be pleased or satisfied. .²2 To be favourable or propitious. .²3 To like, be fond of, take pleasure or delight in, enjoy; सत्त्वं जुषाणस्य भवाय देहिनाम् <ls>Bhāg.</ls> .²4 To devote or attach oneself to, practise, undergo, suffer; पौलस्त्योऽजुषत शुचं विपन्नबन्धुः <ls>Bk. 17. 112</ls>. .²5 To frequent, visit, inhabit; जुषन्ते पर्वतश्रेष्ठमृषयः पर्वसन्धिषु <ls>Mb.</ls> .²6 To enter, seat oneself, resort to; रथं च जुजुषे शुभम् <ls>Bk. 14. 95</ls>. .²7 To choose. .²8 To enjoy, possess, have; <ls>Māl. 5. 18</ls>. .²9 To happen to. .²10 To delight in granting or performing. .²11 To show oneself favourable towards. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To like, be fond of. .²2 To fondle, cherish. .²3 To delight in, approve of, rejoice at. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (जोषति, जोषयति-ते) .²1 To reason, think. .²2 To investigate, examine. .²3 To hurt. .²4 To be satisfied.

जुष् {%a.%} (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Liking, enjoying, taking delight in; <ls>Bh. 3. 103</ls>. .²2 Visiting, approaching, going to, taking, amusing, resorting to <ab>&c.</ab>; परलोकजुषाम् <ls>R. 8. 85</ls>; रजोजुषे जन्मनि <ls>K. 1</ls>.
